scripts.build: vp build --config vite.candidate.config.ts && vp exec node tools/verify-candidate.mjs
scripts.check: vp check package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts vite.candidate.config.ts vite.testkit.config.ts playwright.baseline.config.ts playwright.runtime.config.ts tools tests performance guest && vp run test:unit && vp exec node tools/verify-source-snapshot.mjs && vp run build && vp run build:testkit
scripts.test: vp run check && vp exec playwright test --config playwright.baseline.config.ts tests/baseline.spec.ts && vp exec playwright test --config playwright.runtime.config.ts
scripts.test:update: vp exec playwright test --config playwright.baseline.config.ts tests/baseline.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.perf: vp exec playwright test --config playwright.baseline.config.ts performance/neon-overdrive.perf.spec.ts
